boundary: Isolated Chrome browser contexts; 100 ms virtual clock steps; native pointer input; existing debug goal teleports for stages 1–11. Collision fixtures use imported production modules and 140 HP, not the user’s exact maze. No physical-device or human play acceptance.

comparison.boundary: Independently scheduled live animation frames may differ at a 100-ms observation boundary. Recorded deltas are observations, not an exact equality assertion; matched-step equality is checked below using imported production browser modules.

fixtures.boundary: 140 HP = base 40 + 25 turns × 4. Independent repeated default-wall collisions with production browser modules; not an exact reproduction of the user’s stage.

matchedStepTrace.boundary: Production createStagePlay + createTiltVector imported in Chrome; same native run seed/variation; exact 20-ms calculation steps, observations every 100 ms for 2 s. Separate from independently scheduled live native app traces.
